mission.title: Misanthropy
mission.description: See the intruder's meeting with the Merovingian through, whatever it takes.

npc.say: Let us hope that it goes well.
If I'd known all along that that was who your boss looked like... Hah!
Not that I'm really worried, mind you.
All men have a weakness. This one is no different.

phase.briefing:
Thanks to my skillful manipulation, our affair with the intruder is going swimmingly. He simply couldn't stay away from the party we threw at the Hel Club the other day. He did seem unusually preoccupied with the club's architecture, but frankly--and I've noticed this with you as well, {player}--not everyone knows how to conduct themselves at a party.
Yes, he is something of a troglodyte, but it doesn't do to look down our noses at someone with such a high potential. Why, he's far less aggravating than that love-struck pit bull of Persephone's, Beirn. In fact, he could probably get rid of Beirn for me... Hmm...
What? Oh, yes. He should be meeting up with some of our Exiles. Go see to things.

enter.say: Our programs are in there. I'm getting some unusual activity readings... Oh, I guess the intruder must be there already.
What th--?! Damn it, that's the intruder's code all over our programs! I don't know what happened in there...but you'd better clean those guys up before we get back to Flood.

done.say: All right, that's one thing down. No sign of the intruder himself. We need to find out what's going on.

phase.briefing:
You had to kill our own programs?! Bah! Forget it! I don't want to hear about intruder hexes or any other such nonsense! The restoration fee for those programs is coming out of your paycheck; don't try to weasel out of it!
Look, the intruder is going to meet with the Merovingian, and our boss is going to see how splendidly I've tamed the brute. I won't have you screwing it up! Obviously, you can't handle it yourself... Fine. Go see Malphas. He'll have something to buck up your courage.

enter.say:
Flood wants to get the Merv in the same room with the intruder? After what he just did to our programs? Jeez... Flood's had some bad ideas before, but this really takes the gateau, know what I mean?
Malphas should be in there. I've got a couple redpill readings... No signs of intruder code alterations in my scan, though.

talk.say:
The intruder's manipulation of the code wiped out any chance we had of getting data on what occurred. It's been clear that his temper and intentions are...unpredictable. I can only suggest that you attempt to avoid any course of action that might serve to aggravate him.
I have advised the Merovingian--strongly--not to expose himself to the intruder at this time. He has chosen to proceed with the meeting. Such is the power of bravado. If it does not go well...do what you can. You and these operatives should be less vulnerable to the intruder's influence than our programs are.

done.say: Don't ask me how those two are gonna be much help if the intruder decides to break out the crazy stick...

near.say: You don't think this will take long, do you? I can't stand working with Nekkar.

phase.briefing:
Shake a leg there, {player}! The deal of the cycle is about to go down, orchestrated by moi, and it's your job to record it for posterity!
Security? Pah, you won't be needed for that.

enter.say:
This is it. He and the boss are in there.
Oh man... I can't watch...

talk.say:
I'm surprised as hell that the Machines haven't wiped you and Zion off the map. They're doing a bad job of things. No offense meant, pal, but this just isn't the scheme that was supposed to go down. I'll give you some credit for being resourceful, sure. You seem like an all right guy, relatively speaking. I might have a job for you...but not just yet.
Huh! Finally realized what's been bugging me about you. Your face--I know the guy they got it from. You're supposed to be...what, French? Yeah, that fits. Hah! And here I thought the Machines didn't have a sense of humor.
I... Eh... We will talk about this later, operative. I am just bidding our friend au revoir.

near.say: Wouldn't let us stay in there with him.

phase.briefing:
Didn't he agree to work with us? What more could the Merovingian want? I can't help it if the man thought he recognized him from somewhere.
Just go explain it to him, operative. We have nothing to complain about here.

enter.say:
The Merv should be there. Nothing but friendlies on the scope.
No... I don't really know what to say to him.

talk.say:
Nom de Dieu! The man is insolent... To imply that I am a copy of someone... Of what? Some...some man? And that I might work for him? Who is this, eh? Qui est ce chien?
I will find out. That he has a secret is obvious. And these things he claims to know...he would not have learned them here. Non. His secret lies elsewhere...and I will find it.

near.say: Haven't seen him like this in ages.
Not since Persephone stole that key.

mission.finish: There, you see? He wasn't at all angry with me. It must have been something you did.
